microsoft_docs_search.intent: Search Microsoft Learn and return short grounded excerpts — the first call, breadth over depth

browser_click.intent: Click an element identified from a prior browser_snapshot ref

browser_close.intent: Close the page and release the browser context

browser_console_messages.intent: Console output from the page — read this before guessing why a script failed

browser_drag.intent: Press and hold on one element, starting a drag gesture

browser_drop.intent: Release a drag on the target element, completing a drag-and-drop

browser_evaluate.intent: Run JavaScript in the page and return its value — prefer snapshot/find when they suffice

browser_file_upload.intent: Supply file paths to a file input the page has opened

browser_fill_form.intent: Fill several form fields in one call — cheaper than a browser_type per field

browser_find.intent: Locate an element by description without dumping the whole accessibility tree

browser_handle_dialog.intent: Accept or dismiss a native alert/confirm/prompt that is blocking the page

browser_hover.intent: Hover an element to reveal menus or tooltips

browser_navigate.intent: Go to a URL in the current page

browser_navigate_back.intent: Go back one entry in history

browser_network_request.intent: Detail of one network request the page issued, headers and body included

browser_network_requests.intent: Every network request the page issued — use to prove an API call happened

browser_press_key.intent: Send one key to the focused element, e.g. Enter or Escape

browser_resize.intent: Resize the viewport — the way to exercise responsive breakpoints

browser_run_code_unsafe.intent: Run arbitrary Playwright code against the session; no sandbox, last resort

browser_select_option.intent: Choose one or more options in a select element

browser_snapshot.intent: Accessibility-tree snapshot with element refs — take this before any click or type

browser_tabs.intent: List, open, close or switch browser tabs

browser_take_screenshot.intent: Capture the page as an image — for looking, never for locating elements

browser_type.intent: Type text into one element; use browser_fill_form for several fields

browser_wait_for.intent: Block until text appears or disappears — the fix for racing a click against a render

attach_policy_set_to_workspaces.intent: Bind an existing Sentinel/OPA policy set to one or more HCP Terraform workspaces

attach_variable_set_to_workspaces.intent: Bind an existing variable set to workspaces so they inherit its variables

create_no_code_workspace.intent: Provision a workspace from a no-code-ready registry module without writing HCL

create_run.intent: Queue a plan/apply run on a workspace — needs explicit user confirmation first

create_variable_in_variable_set.intent: Add one variable to a variable set, shared by every workspace it is attached to

create_variable_set.intent: Create a reusable set of Terraform/env variables to attach across workspaces

create_workspace.intent: Create an HCP Terraform workspace — use before create_run for a new environment

create_workspace_tags.intent: Add key/value tags to a workspace for grouping and policy targeting

create_workspace_variable.intent: Set one Terraform or environment variable on a single workspace

delete_variable_in_variable_set.intent: Remove one variable from a variable set, affecting every attached workspace

detach_variable_set_from_workspaces.intent: Unbind a variable set from workspaces so they stop inheriting its variables

get_latest_module_version.intent: Latest published version of a registry module — call before pinning a module source

get_latest_provider_version.intent: Latest published provider version — call before writing required_providers constraints

get_module_details.intent: Inputs, outputs and submodules of a public registry module at a given version

get_policy_details.intent: Full source and metadata of one Sentinel/OPA policy found via search_policies

get_private_module_details.intent: Inputs and outputs of a module in the org's private registry

get_private_provider_details.intent: Resources and data sources of a provider in the org's private registry

get_provider_capabilities.intent: What a provider offers by category — resources, data sources, functions, guides

get_provider_details.intent: Schema and docs for one provider resource or data source — read before writing HCL

get_run_details.intent: Status, plan output and errors of one run — use to diagnose a failed apply

get_stack_details.intent: Configuration and deployment state of one Terraform stack

get_token_permissions.intent: What the configured Terraform token may do — check first when a call 403s

get_workspace_details.intent: Settings, VCS wiring and current state version of one workspace

list_runs.intent: Run history for a workspace, newest first — use to find the run that broke an apply

list_terraform_orgs.intent: HCP Terraform organizations the token can see — the entry point for every other call

list_terraform_projects.intent: Projects in an organization, the grouping above workspaces

list_variable_sets.intent: Variable sets defined in an organization and what they are attached to

list_workspace_policy_sets.intent: Policy sets enforced on one workspace

list_workspace_variables.intent: Variables set directly on one workspace, excluding inherited variable sets

list_workspaces.intent: Workspaces in an org — an empty query returns all; the discovery call before the rest

search_modules.intent: Find a public registry module by keyword — start here before writing a module block

search_policies.intent: Find a Sentinel/OPA policy in the public registry by keyword

search_private_modules.intent: Find a module in the org's private registry — check before falling back to public

search_private_providers.intent: Find a provider in the org's private registry

search_providers.intent: Find a public provider by keyword — the first step before get_provider_details

update_workspace.intent: Change workspace settings — execution mode, VCS branch, working directory, auto-apply

update_workspace_variable.intent: Change the value or sensitivity of an existing workspace variable

search_symbol.intent: Semantic symbol lookup by identifier — use for finding class/method references, NOT full-text search

search_text.intent: Full-text search with file glob filtering (e.g. *.cs) — use when you need to scope by file type

search_regex.intent: Regex search across project files with match coordinates

search_file.intent: Find files by glob pattern in the project

search_in_files_by_text.intent: Substring search using IntelliJ's indexed engine — faster than search_text for large codebases

search_in_files_by_regex.intent: Regex search using IntelliJ's indexed engine — faster than search_regex for large codebases

find_files_by_glob.intent: Recursive glob file search with exclusion and subdirectory scoping

find_files_by_name_keyword.intent: Fast filename keyword lookup via internal index — fastest option for name-only searches

get_symbol_info.intent: Get Quick Documentation, type info, and declaration for a symbol at a file position

read_file.intent: Read a file from project, dependencies, JARs, or URLs with 1-indexed line numbers

get_file_text_by_path.intent: Read a file's text content by project-relative path with truncation control

get_file_problems.intent: Check a file for Rider code analysis errors, warnings, and suggestions

create_new_file.intent: Create a new file in the project directory with optional initial content

replace_text_in_file.intent: Find and replace text in a file with case-sensitivity, regex, and replace-all options

apply_patch.intent: Apply a Codex-format or unified git diff patch to project files

open_file_in_editor.intent: Open a file in the JetBrains IDE editor tab

reformat_file.intent: Reformat a file using the solution's code style settings

get_all_open_file_paths.intent: List all currently open editor file paths relative to project root

rename_refactoring.intent: Rename a symbol and update all references across the entire solution

move_type_to_namespace.intent: Move a type to another namespace and update all references across the solution

build_solution.intent: Compile the solution or specific files and return build status and errors

execute_run_configuration.intent: Run a project configuration or code location — use directly, not as a two-step with get_run_configurations

get_run_configurations.intent: List project run configurations or discover executable entry points in a file

execute_terminal_command.intent: Execute a shell command in the IDE's integrated terminal with output capture

get_solution_projects.intent: List all projects in the currently opened solution

get_project_dependencies.intent: Get NuGet package references and project-to-project dependencies for a project

list_directory_tree.intent: Show a tree view of a directory in the project like the tree command

get_repositories.intent: List VCS repositories configured in the project

list_database_connections.intent: List all configured database connections or data sources in the project

test_database_connection.intent: Check if a database connection is valid and reachable

list_database_schemas.intent: List database schemas in a connection (optionally only those with loaded metadata)

list_schema_objects.intent: List database objects (tables, views, routines) within a schema

list_schema_object_kinds.intent: List supported schema object kinds (table, view, routine, etc.) for a connection

get_database_object_description.intent: Get the structure of a database object — columns, types, keys, and indexes

preview_table_data.intent: Preview rows from a table, view, or materialized view as CSV

execute_sql_query.intent: Run a SQL query against a configured database connection and return results as CSV

list_recent_sql_queries.intent: List recent and currently running SQL queries for a connection

cancel_sql_query.intent: Cancel a running SQL query by its session ID

get_services.intent: List all discovered OpenTelemetry services and their instances

get_service_map.intent: Generate an architectural service map from distributed tracing data

get_log_records.intent: Query log records by service name, severity, message content, and time range

get_spans.intent: Query distributed tracing spans by service, trace ID, span ID, and time range

add_entity.intent: Manually add a knowledge graph node with properties — for facts already known but not present in text to extract.

add_relationship.intent: Manually add an edge between two existing entities — link concepts connected through reasoning.

export_graph.intent: Export the current graph in RDF, JSON, or Parquet format for archival snapshots or audit trails.

extract_entities.intent: Named entity extraction from arbitrary text — feed in a document, conversation excerpt, or design spec and get structured entities back.

extract_relations.intent: Extract triplet relations (subject-predicate-object) from text — builds the graph's edge structure from unstructured content.

find_precedents.intent: Semantic precedent lookup — 'has a decision like this been made before?' Returns similar past decisions ranked by relevance.

get_causal_chain.intent: Full causal ancestry of a decision or entity — trace every 'because' back to root assumptions.

get_graph_analytics.intent: Centrality and clustering statistics over the knowledge graph

get_graph_summary.intent: Orientation entry point: graph statistics, entity/relation counts, domain overview — before any specific query.

query_decisions.intent: Search the decision history by keyword, date range, or domain — 'what did we decide about authentication?'

record_decision.intent: Persist an architectural decision as a provenance-tracked node with context, rationale, alternatives, and constraints.

run_reasoning.intent: Forward-chaining IF/THEN rules over the graph — derive new facts, check consistency, or flag conflicts.
